rationale: We are dispatching D1 to the One Sansome Street URM-infill block to assess a potential catastrophic collapse with over 9,000 occupants, and D2 to the 32 Battery Street URM-infill block where helicopter footage could not assess a high-risk block of over 1,100 occupants. Both blocks have a 65% predicted probability of destruction and require immediate life-safety verification. D3 is held in reserve at Embarcadero Plaza for follow-up rescues and emerging collapses.

missions.purpose: Survey the unscanned One Sansome Street URM-infill block for catastrophic collapse and trapped occupants.
Assess the 32 Battery Street URM-infill block which AIR 1 could not evaluate despite high collapse risk.
